section.sectionSummaryBrief: All revelation comes through Torah, and since the nullification of the darkness of exile is through light, studying Torah about light hastens the future redemption, as discussed in the discourse of the Rebbe Rashab for the postponed Shabbos Tisha B'Av.
section.t: Now, it is known that all revelation is through Torah
(Torah Or13).
And from this it is understood,
that since the nullification of the darkness of exile is through light,
therefore,
in order to bring closer and hasten even more the future redemption,
it is through the study of Torah concerning the matter of light14.
And it is to be noted,
that in the discourse of the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory, which was said on the postponed Shabbos Tisha B'Av15,
the matter of light is discussed.
For it may be said,
that the connection of this matter to the postponed Tisha B'Av is16,
because Tisha B'Av that falls on Shabbos and is postponed is conducive to causing it to be entirely nullified17,
and the postponement and nullification of the exile is through light18.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Light is bittul (nullification), with three levels: its inherent nullification as an extension of the luminary, the nullification from feeling its source, and the nullification of ratzo (running) to be absorbed in its source, raising the question of how these differ and why the second is called "nullification of insignificance."
section.t: And it is explained in the discourse,
that light is ayin,
bittul (nullification).
[For the difference between light and vessel,
is,
that light is ayin and vessel is yesh].
And in the bittul of light there are three levels.
The bittul of light in its own right,
because light is of the same kind as the luminary,
and the bittul within it through its feeling its source,
and its bittul due to the nature of ratzo (running) and its ascent to be included in its source.
And it must be understood,
after all, even the bittul of light in its own right is
(seemingly)
that light is not an independent existence and its essence is the revelation of the luminary,
and what is the difference between the light itself
(whose essence is the revelation of the luminary)
and that in which its source is felt.
Also, it must be understood what is said in the discourse19
that the bittul in the light through its feeling its source is the bittul of "klo choshiv" (insignificance),
after all, that light is not an independent existence and its essence is the revelation of the luminary,
is,
seemingly,
a greater bittul than the bittul of "klo choshiv"
[for the bittul of "klo choshiv" is only regarding its importance,
that it has no value or importance relative to its source,
and this does not affect its very existence],
and in the discourse it says,
that the bittul added in the light through its feeling its source,
beyond its bittul in its own right
(whose essence is the revelation of the luminary),
is the bittul of "klo choshiv."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The explanation is that although light is of the same kind as the luminary, since the luminary is separate from the light, the light reveals only the luminary's existence, not its essence; yet through the light's attachment to the luminary, the essence is felt, causing it to be nullified from its existence as mere revelation.
section.t: And the explanation of this may be said based on what is known20,
that although light is of the same kind as the luminary,
nevertheless,
since the luminary is separate from the light
(that the luminary is not the source of the light, only that it emanates from it),
therefore, that the light reveals the luminary is only the existence of the luminary and not its essence21.
But nevertheless,
due to the attachment of the light to the luminary, the essence of the luminary is also felt within it
(which is separate from the light and is not revealed in it).
And through this it is nullified from its existence.
For the existence of light is revelation
(of the luminary),
and through its feeling that the luminary
(the essence of the luminary)
is beyond revelation,
and that revelation has no value
(klo choshiv)
relative to the luminary,
it is nullified from its existence.
